question.problem: Find the average acceleration of a particle on the interval $[0,2]$ if its acceleration in ${\text{mm/s}}^{2}$ is given by the function $a(t)={e}^{t}+2t,$ where $t$ is the time in seconds.
question.worked_solution:
To calculate the average value of the acceleration on $[{t}_{1},{t}_{2}],$ we use the average value formula

$$
{a}_{\text{avg}}=\frac{1}{{t}_{2}-{t}_{1}}\,{\int }_{{t}_{1}}^{{t}_{2}}a(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

So, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{2-0}\,{\int }_{0}^{2}({e}^{t}+2t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{t}+{t}^{2}){|}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[({e}^{2}+{2}^{2})-({e}^{0}+{0}^{2})] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{2}+4-1) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}({e}^{2}+3).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the average acceleration is $\frac{1}{2}({e}^{2}+3)\,{\text{mm/s}}^{2}.$
